faq.q: Can two people book the same table at once?
faq.a: No. Double booking is stopped at the heart of the system, so one place can only ever hold one booking at a time.

faq.q: Do guests need an account to book?
faq.a: No. They book on your booking page and get an email with a link to move or cancel.

faq.q: Can I take a deposit when someone books?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a deposit by payment link. The booking is held while they pay and confirms itself when the money arrives.
